uzo.purpose: Chooses one of a few options that all stay visible: payment method, shipping speed, yes/no/maybe; an option may carry a short description (its attribute description).

instead.kialo: Six or more options, or an unknown number, belong in a list that opens on demand, because a group that long is no longer read; Fundamento covers it with elektilo.
A yes or no is a check mark, because a box that is ticked or not says it with one control where two options would ask twice; Fundamento covers it with markobutono.
Several options at once are the plurelektilo's, because a radio group holds exactly one answer; it shows the chosen as a count or as tags (Spec 025 ③ closes the alternative multi).

boundary.kialo: A choice of one is no choice, because a person cannot pick between options that are not there; one option is a checkbox or a text.
A radio group without a visible label shows options without the question, because the circles say which answer is chosen and only the label says to what.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A choice without a form has no sender, because its answer is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for one of a few answers before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need it (shipping speed).

containers.name: filter-bar
containers.kialo: A filter of a few values stays visible above the list it narrows, because a person sees at once which filter holds.

with.kialo: A choice stands among the fields of a form, one below the other, because a person reads a form top down and answers it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because choosing an option does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field.

never.kialo: A radio group stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the options could not be reached on their own.

case.de: Es gibt sechs oder mehr Optionen, oder ihre Zahl ist nicht bekannt.
case.en: There are six or more options, or their number is not known.

case.de: Die Frage lässt sich mit Ja oder Nein beantworten.
case.en: The question can be answered with yes or no.

case.de: Mehrere Optionen dürfen zugleich gewählt sein.
case.en: Several options may be chosen at once.

do.de: Stell die Frage in der Beschriftung und lass jede Option eine eigene Antwort sein.
do.en: Put the question in the label and let every option be an answer of its own.

do.de: Erkläre eine Option bei Bedarf mit ihrer kurzen Beschreibung.
do.en: Explain an option where needed with its short description.

do.de: Nimm orientation horizontal nur für bis zu drei kurze Optionen.
do.en: Use orientation horizontal only for up to three short options.

dont.de: Eine Gruppe mit nur einer Option bauen, denn eine Wahl braucht mindestens zwei.
dont.en: Build a group with a single option, because a choice needs at least two.

dont.de: Die Größe large neu setzen: Sie ist ein veralteter Name für medium und wird als medium gezeigt.
dont.en: Set the size large anew: it is a deprecated name for medium and is shown as medium.
Place options with the same wording side by side.

action.de: Geht zur nächsten Option und wählt sie, nach der letzten wieder zur ersten.
action.en: Moves to the next option and chooses it, after the last back to the first.

action.de: Geht zur vorigen Option und wählt sie, vor der ersten zur letzten.
action.en: Moves to the previous option and chooses it, before the first to the last.

action.de: Wählt die Option mit dem Fokus.
action.en: Chooses the option that has the focus.
